# Public-source review supporting PD-PLATFORM-20260920-01

**Review date:** 20 September 2026  
**GitHub base:** 62f8cb696841ff5de9726f454cd7b71c416e5b93  
**Scope:** existing public GitLab asset-recovery, anti-corruption/institutional-integrity, European-funds and claimant-rights material; current legal text and corporate identity. No authenticated GitLab repository request was made.

## 1. Review result and method

The new whole-platform rule joins existing source strands rather than inventing a new asset history. Four public HTML pages were retrieved with substantial parsed content and reviewed for the relevant sections: the recovery guide, the LPB solvency/patrimonial-rights page, the 7-June displacement dossier, and the multiple-financial-lives dossier. The Intervencion/SIINF page was available through indexed public excerpts; direct openings failed in this review. Several direct Spanish/cross-linked route openings also returned retrieval errors. A failed fetch is not proof that a page was deleted, unpublished or absent from GitLab.

This is a bounded thematic review, not a claim to have read the entire site, every annex or the blocked repository. Indexed public material is not a live-byte-parity check. Prior attachments that have expired were not substituted with invented native content. Existing GitHub source syntheses were read through the connector; they remain syntheses, not new independent corroboration of their underlying exhibits.

## 2. Existing public recovery guide

URL: https://por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup-c2b10f.gitlab.io/por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup/en/authorities-duties-asset-recovery/

The page retains the attributed organised/coordinated/continuous criminal allegation, direct/transformed/equivalent-value recovery, separately competent authorities, proportionate intervention and protection of lawful activity. It identifies Aweswell as the UK holding company/foreign investor while distinguishing its direct rights from Spanish-company losses. It does not treat confiscation as automatic delivery to the complainant.

**Rule implication:** preserve these protections while making the enquiry into pre-income commercial commitments, opportunities, repeated financing and gains explicit. Direct hotel-cash tracing is one lane, not the whole investigation.

The guide also distinguishes the prospectus and accounts-based Series F/G figures. This update does not normalise that discrepancy, certify a new total or imply that any amount is criminal proceeds.

## 3. Existing solvency, platform and public-liability record

Retrieved URL: https://por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup-c2b10f.gitlab.io/en/lpb-solvency-record/

The page separates asset coverage, cash-flow insolvency and the asserted necessity of liquidation. It identifies three recovery perimeters: within the concurso, outside it (including Aweswell, Matkator, exploitation/platform interests), and administration-specific public-service harm. It already contains Articles 32–37, Article 32.7/LOPJ and a prescription warning.

**Rule implication:** economic unity must not extinguish separate ownership/standing; legal fragmentation must not reduce the alleged harm to LPB alone. No new valuation, guaranteed financing outcome or Companies House verification of directors' assertions is inferred.

## 4. Existing 7-June displacement record

URL: https://por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup-c2b10f.gitlab.io/por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup/en/sun-park-takeover-7-june-2018/

The page separately addresses property, possession, business, customers/goodwill and the funded-exit opportunity. It preserves adverse criminal-procedure outcomes and disputes about causation, authority and title. Its account of the platform is broader than a post-title rent claim.

**Rule implication:** retain the 2017–2018 preparatory baseline, the approximate 2018 displacement allegation and the later commercial uses without backdating later instruments or converting signed conditional opportunities into completed funding.

## 5. Existing multiple-financial-lives and European-funds record

URL: https://por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup-c2b10f.gitlab.io/por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup/en/same-hotel-multiple-financial-lives/

The page expressly alleges repeated use of substantially overlapping economic bases, not simply the innocent coexistence of labels. It calls for property-, invoice-, job-, period- and euro-specific reconciliation while distinguishing the statutory RIC, RICPE, national regional incentives, State aid and FEDER. It identifies the EU/ERDF project connection and retains gaps concerning the precise operation, percentage, expenditure, payments and controls.

**Rule implication:** neither dilute the repeated-use allegation into a generic funding inventory nor promote it into proved double funding. Corporate relationships and an absence of a traced bank transfer are both insufficient to decide whether another branch benefited through rights, opportunity, information, security or a contractual mandate. The corresponding legal basis must be identified separately.

## 6. Anti-corruption / institutional-integrity handling

Indexed public route: https://por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup-c2b10f.gitlab.io/por-derecho-setup-or-gitlab-setup/en/intervencion-general-siinf-traceability/

Direct retrieval failed; indexed content and the existing GitHub unitary protocol distinguish the three Intervencion responses and their different functions. No new finding of corruption, acknowledgement of guilt, universal clearance of aid or completed independent investigation is drawn from those records.

**Rule implication:** investigate relevant acts and omissions, knowledge, duty, corrective capacity, decision and economic consequence; do not infer improper influence from institutional position or ordinary public recognition. Preserve the allegation at its actual strength and identify the next records needed to test it.

## 7. Current primary checks

- Companies House, AWESWELL LIMITED, 07716847: active; incorporated 25 July 2011; former name Monterecco Sun Park Limited. This verifies the current registry identity/status only. https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/07716847
- Ley 40/2015: Articles 32–37, including the judicial-system referral in 32.7, concurrent-administration rules in 33, and the non-automatic-suspension rule in 37.2. https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-10566
- Ley 39/2015: Article 67, including general prescription and required claim particulars. https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-10565#a67
- LOPJ: Articles 292–297, including distinct judicial-error recognition and abnormal-functioning routes under Article 293. https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1985-12666

The standing rule uses these as procedural safeguards, not as a merits opinion establishing liability or the absence of limitation. Historical acts require their historical law. No UK investment-treaty or jurisdictional entitlement was established by this review.

GitHub commit, PR, merge, checks and any live deployment must be reported from actual tool results. This document does not declare itself deployed. GitLab parity remains unverified until repository access returns and the then-current state can be compared. Any later website propagation must retain bilingual source/status and filing boundaries and respect the current user-authorised scope.
